The included battery provides up to 2 years of power for round-the-clock security.
Detects motion within a 100° field of view and up to 30 feet (9 m) away — enough to cover an entire room of your home.
Tailor the sensitivity of the sensor so that it only alerts you when people are in range, rather than your playful dog or cat.
Notifies you as soon as motion is detected by sending a message to your phone via the eufy Security app, no matter where you are.
Connects to the eufy Security HomeBase (sold separately) as well as other eufy Security products. Pair it in the eufy Security app, then press the button on the sensor to add it to your system.
